title: feat(plugin-auth,objectql,metadata-protocol,runtime)!: under `single` the Default Organization exists before the seeds and the listener; an unowned seed row or system write is derived there or refused (ADR-0131 C1)
body:
Fixes #15195
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

> ⚠️ **Not landable yet — a decision is open.** The implementation, its pins and the package suites are green. The `Dogfood Regression Gate` is not: 24 dogfood files (36 tests, plus beforeAll failures) fail at this head and pass at its base, because C1 retires the "pure single-tenant, no organization" shape that `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack` pins and those fixtures encode. Who re-pins them, and where, is the open question on #15195 (the os-dev report there). The table under "Dogfood" lists every file and its cause.

The claim of record reads `Clause-②: no`. The line above is the measured one (built entry declarations, base against head, below); the seat revises the claim.

## What this does (ADR-0131 C1, as triage scoped it in 6040634630: Q1 → B)

- **The boot invariant (D3).** Under the `single` posture in force, `AuthPlugin.start()` finds or creates the Default Organization (`slug: 'default'`), with or without a platform admin. A failed read or insert throws and fails the boot. `AppPlugin` declares `com.objectstack.auth` as an order-if-present dependency, so the kernel starts the auth plugin first wherever a host registered it. The organization therefore exists before the inline seed and before `kernel:listening`.
- **The seed-exemption withdrawal (D3/D9).** The seed loader stamps the install's organization on every row of an object that carries an `organization_id` column, `sys_` / `cloud_` / `ai_` seeds included. With no organization pinned and none derivable (zero, or several) on an install that registers the organization object, such a row is refused, counted and named. An object with no organization column is never stamped (see the correction below).
- **The owner pin (D3 / ADR-0093 D7).** The reconciler now binds the first admin as `member` before the owner bind learns who they are. While the once-only bind is undecided and the Default Organization has no owner, the bootstrap promotes that row to `owner` in place, and records the decision as `promoted`.
- **The derivation rule for the objects already in scope (D9).** `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` derives at exactly one organization, and refuses at zero (new: `reason: 'no-organization'`), at several, and under a wall. The refusal reuses `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED` (status 500). No `packages/spec` edit.
- **Unchanged by ruling.** The 49 gated platform objects keep `isPlatformObjectOutOfTenantAuditScope` until C8. The lean-install branch (`probeInstallOrganizations` answering `[]` when no organization object is registered) is unchanged, with a pin. No C3, C5 or C6 surface, no seeder and no `applyTenantScope` is touched.
- The body's #11973 paragraph was dropped per triage 6018598650: that card closed `completed`, with both halves landed in `4f65837a7f` before this card was cut.

## Taken over, and what changed in the inherited commits

This continues the branch a previous dev left at `9ee45a1695` (four `wip` commits and a `main` merge, no report). Every hunk was re-read against the ruling, and every verification was re-run here.

| file | disposition |
| :--- | :--- |
| `objectql/src/engine.ts`, `objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts` | kept |
| `plugin-auth/src/ensure-default-organization.ts` | corrected: the boot invariant moved to a new internal module, `default-organization-invariant.ts`, which the package barrel does not export (no consumer outside the plugin); an unused helper removed |
| `plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`, `default-org-bootstrap-once.ts` | kept (import and doc pointer repointed) |
| `metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` | corrected: the inherited withdrawal stamped `organization_id` on objects that carry no such column; the engine refuses an undeclared field, so on a real kernel those seed rows were dropped (measured on the pin's `tenancy: { enabled: false }` object: `Unknown field 'organization_id' on object 'pin_licence'`). The stamp now applies only where `seedRowNeedsOrganization` holds, whether the organization was named or derived. |
| `runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` | kept (the ordering it declares is measured and ablated below) |
| the re-pinned existing tests (M5) | kept, each judged below |
| `seed-loader-organization-stamp.test.ts`, `auth-plugin.test.ts`, `ensure-default-organization.test.ts` | corrected: controls for the column-less object; the engine doubles route through the engine's own dispatch predicates (`check:engine-double-contract`), the new `auth-plugin.test.ts` update double is recorded in `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`, and the seed fake refuses a WHERE combinator (`check:where-matcher`) |
| changesets | metadata-protocol and plugin-auth corrected (the column-aware stamp, every user bound from the first boot, the in-memory driver consequence, the TypeScript surface), objectql kept; all three carry the measured `Clause-②` line |

Added: `runtime/src/default-organization-boot-invariant.pin.test.ts` (a real kernel, two boots), and the tenant-audit census regenerated for the two new system writes (`content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx`, `docs/audits/2026-08-tenant-audit-write-call-sites.counts.md`, 233 → 235).

**M5, the re-pinned existing tests.** Every flip was judged against the ruling; none was restored.
- The old expectation WAS the defect C1 fixes, so the flip is correct: `seed-loader-sole-organization-read-failure` (no organization, several, or an unprovisioned table no longer write the row NULL), `objectql/seed-loader-org-fallback` (`sys_` seeds take the organization; ambiguity refuses), `engine-organization-probe-outage` cause 2 (the empty probe still is not an outage, but zero organizations now refuses), `system-write-tenancy-autonumber-split.integration` (the first-boot write is refused at zero organizations, with the stamped control), `auth-plugin.test.ts` "`autoDefaultOrganization: false` opts out" (the organization exists anyway).
- The fixture changed and the subject did not: `seed-loader-engine-schema-fallback` (the one new engine read is the organization-object registration read), `seed-loader-existing-records-read-failure` (the metadata double no longer claims an organization object), `protocol-publish-package-drafts`, `packages-seed-apply-disclosure`, `packages-seed-apply-read-decorations`, `http-dispatcher` (each install now holds its Default Organization), `seed-tenancy-autonumber-split.integration` (the split is reproduced from pre-C1 residue written at the driver, since the loader can no longer produce it, and a new case pins the refusal), and the two `auth-plugin.test.ts` `app:seeded` cases (they delete the organization to reach "no target").

## Boot order — fresh `single`, `examples/app-showcase` through `@objectstack/verify` `bootStack` (measured)

Base `51290bca2c`, head `c49f46bab1` (same implementation as this head). Seeds: 132 rows over 19 objects.

| step | base | head |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `AuthPlugin.start()` | no organization | Default Organization inserted — the first insert of the boot (seq 0 of 98) |
| `AppPlugin.start()` inline seed | 132 rows, all `organization_id` NULL (`sys_business_unit` 5 of 5 NULL) | 132 rows, 0 NULL, `sys_business_unit` included |
| `kernel:ready` | 0 organizations | 1 |
| `kernel:listening` | 0 organizations (harness default); 1 only when a dev admin exists at `kernel:ready` (`orgContext: true`: the organization was the 49th insert, after every seed, and 130 of 132 seed rows stayed NULL) | 1 |
| dev admin, owner bind on (`orgContext: true`) | org created and admin bound `owner` directly | reconciler binds `member`, the bootstrap logs "promoted the platform admin to owner"; `isPlatformAdmin: true`, positions `platform_admin`, `org_owner` |
| dev admin, owner bind off (harness default) | no membership, no active organization | `member` of the Default Organization, which is the session's active organization |

## The derivation rule — `resolveSystemInsertOrganization`, objects in scope

| posture | organizations | organization object registered | write carries one | base | head |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `single` | 1 | yes | no | derived | derived |
| `single` | 0 | yes | no | lands NULL (measured, probe) | refused `no-organization` (measured, pins) |
| `single` | 2 or more | yes | no | refused `ambiguous-organization` | unchanged |
| `single` | 0 | no (lean composition) | no | lands unstamped | unchanged, pinned |
| `isolated` / `group` | any | yes | no | refused `walled-posture` | unchanged (measured on a `posture-only` isolated showcase boot: code `ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`, status 500; the same insert carrying `tenantId` lands stamped) |
| any | any | any | yes | stamped with it | unchanged |
| the 49 gated platform objects | any | any | no | exempt | unchanged (C8) |

## Acceptance pins (head `4fc2472fd0`, base `ec8f37c890`)

`runtime/src/default-organization-boot-invariant.pin.test.ts` boots a real kernel twice: kernel A as a fresh deployment nobody signed up to, kernel B as `objectstack dev` (the dev admin is created after the organization exists). `AppPlugin` is registered before `AuthPlugin` on purpose.

| pin | where | base | head | control |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| (a) organization before the listener and before the first seed row; an `isSystem` insert with no organization lands stamped | kernel A, 3 cases | red (0 organizations at `kernel:listening`; no organization insert; the insert lands NULL) | green | an object declaring `tenancy: { enabled: false }` takes none |
| (b) `isolated` / `group` refuse, with the code and status; the insert carrying `tenantId` lands | `objectql` `system-write-organization.test.ts` (#8844 cases, pre-existing) and the measured isolated boot above | green (since #8844) | green | the carrying insert |
| (c) the first admin is the owner, by promotion | kernel B | red: the organization did not predate the admin, so the bind inserted `owner` directly and the reconciler's `member` precondition never arises | green | `isPlatformAdmin` read back unchanged |
| (d) every seed row stamped, `sys_` seeds included | kernel A | red (seed rows NULL) | green | the tenancy-off seed lands with no organization |
| (e) lean-install branch unchanged | `objectql` and `metadata-protocol` `[ADR-0131 Q2, held as-is]` cases | green | green | the registered-but-empty case refuses |

Kernel A's first sign-up over HTTP is also pinned as `owner` (green at base and head: on that path the owner bind lands before the reconciler).

**Reverse verification**, run from committed `4fc2472fd0`: the implementation's eight source paths restored to `ec8f37c890` in the tree only, the four packages rebuilt, `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` confirming each head marker absent from `dist/`, the pin run (5 failed, 2 passed, as tabled), then a trap restore proven by `git diff HEAD` empty and per-path blob hashes equal to HEAD, and a rebuild with the markers present again.

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored and rebuilt):
- The promotion call itself disabled (`ensure-default-organization.ts`): kernel B's (c) turns red (`member`, not `owner`); the other six stay green. Two earlier attempts did not measure this and are void: the first marker was a comment the bundler strips, so the preflight could not prove it reached `dist/`; the second disabled only the `return`, and the promotion's own update still ran.
- `com.objectstack.auth` removed from `AppPlugin.optionalDependencies`: the seed runs before the organization exists, every seed row is refused, and (a)'s ordering case and (d) turn red.

## Dogfood — the open question

At this head, 24 dogfood files fail; at the base the same 24 files pass (`218 passed`). Each fails because a fixture relied on a `single` boot having no organization:

| cause | files |
| :--- | :--- |
| the fixture mints its own `slug: 'default'` organization, which now exists (`DuplicateRecordError`) | `membership-reconciler`, `membership-role-vocabulary`, `membership-ended-session-revoke`, `membership-actor-attribution`, `delegated-admin-invite` |
| an org-less principal is the precondition, and every sign-up is now a member of the Default Organization | `sharing-rule-org-less-caller` (13), `armed` (4), `parent-derived-write-refusal-not-visible`, `write-door-unreadable-is-not-found`, `predicate-write-unreadable-not-matched` |
| the `driver='memory'` variant: the memory driver refuses a tenant-scoped read, and every session now carries an organization (`503`) | `analytics-adhoc-query-isolation`, `analytics-inline-dataset-isolation`, `analytics-inline-dataset-admission`, `analytics-contains-membership` |
| the harness admin is now a `member` of the organization, not an org-less platform admin | `permission-set-lock-row-provenance`, `permission-set-write-through-package-binding`, `showcase-permission-projection`, `sys-file-metadata-write-refusal`, `two-doors-permission` |
| the old expectation is the defect C1 fixes (a `sys_business_unit` created with no organization) | `single-tenant-identity-create` |
| other organization interplay (needs a per-file read) | `delegation-of-duty`, `invitation-ledger-row-scope`, `org-admin-affordance-reach`, `organization-delete-federated-fixture` (deleting the organization now clears it on the seeded rows) |

The memory-driver refusal is not new in production terms: at base, the same showcase boot with the owner bind on (`orgContext: true`, the shape `objectstack dev` boots) answers the platform admin's `GET /data/showcase_category` with `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` on the memory driver. Only the harness's org-less pin kept those variants green.

An experiment (not committed): with the harness's owner bind on for every boot, the fourth group (5 files) passes and 19 files still fail.

## Clause-② — the built entry declarations, base `ec8f37c890` against head

- `@objectstack/objectql`: `SystemWriteOrganizationDecision`'s `'no-organization-yet'` becomes `'no-organization-object'`; `SystemWriteRefusalReason` gains `'no-organization'`; `resolveSystemWriteOrganization` takes a required `organizationObjectRegistered`.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: `EnsureDefaultOrganizationOnceOptions` gains an optional `organizationCreatedByThisProcess`; `EnsureDefaultOrganizationResult` gains an optional `ownerPromoted` and the `'owner_promotion_failed'` reason.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`: no public declaration changes.

So the surface widens (an option, a field, two literals) and the accept sets narrow: `yes (narrowing)`. All three changesets are `minor` with the BREAKING banner and an ADR-0087 disposition (`.changeset/pre.json` is absent on `origin/main`).

## Verification (head `4fc2472fd0`)

- Tests: `@objectstack/objectql` 381 files, 7,527 passed; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 222 files, 28,251 passed; `@objectstack/plugin-auth` 126 files, 2,642 passed; `@objectstack/runtime` 337 files, 5,469 passed. Typecheck green for all four, `check:test-typecheck` included.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 110 for this tree; all 110 run, 109 exit 0. `check-engine-split-ratio --days 90` refuses on this shallow clone (prerequisite, not measured); `--ran` reconciles 110 of 110.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the 24 TypeScript files this diff touches: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 24 files in the JSON report. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. The full `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- Dogfood: all 8 shards run at this head; the 24 files above fail and every other file passes.

## Acceptance notes

- `bootStack`'s docs (`orgContext`, and the "pure single-tenant (no org, no scoping)" comment) describe a shape this change removes; they move with whatever the decision on #15195 is.
- The seed loader's sole-organization fallback still derives under a walled posture when a load names no organization and the install holds exactly one (read, not measured; the walled inline seed is suppressed and the per-organization replay always names one).
- The once-only owner bind can run on two concurrent triggers. At head the bind is promoted while the ledger records `admin-already-member`, and the second ledger insert is refused `DUPLICATE_RECORD`; the same refusal appears at base (an observation, not a reproduced defect).
